Round 399 is not complete: I stopped on one part of the task that needs your ruling. The rest of the migration is done, and the three migrated specs pass on the working tree with every row value matching the earlier unchanged run.

**STOP — needs B ruling: rule R-b for the Ctrl+D group copy in the interactions spec.** Rule R-b says to scroll a clip into the lane area before reading it, but here that changes the starting state.
- On the unchanged code at 1440×900, the copy starts at 4566 px while the lane area is 512–1440 px, so each read needs a scroll of about 4000 px.
- Two of the five copy reads in `measureGroupDrag` happen during playback. A manual scroll during playback pauses Follow, and it stays paused after scrolling back and after Home (`a-round-399/probe/follow-probe.txt`). That changes the state before the measurement starts, which the "rows must equal HEAD" rule forbids.
- I left the copy-id lookup (old l.914–915) and those copy reads unchanged. The lookup runs while stopped and could be migrated: after Ctrl+D the detail panel shows the copy's start (101.352), so it can be named without being mounted. Migrating it alone would make the virtualization run stall instead of skipping cleanly, so I didn't.
- Candidate for your ruling, not applied: scroll to the copy only when it isn't mounted. That means no scroll at all on today's code.
